snapshot.capital_scaled: ₹1–5 crore for a type-approved vehicle, assembly line and dealer network
snapshot.distribution_note: Dealers, fleets and B2B buyers drive sales; service network matters

tailwinds: India's EV sales keep growing, especially two- and three-wheelers.
The PM E-DRIVE scheme and state EV policies support buyers and manufacturers.
Delivery fleets and e-rickshaw operators need affordable, rugged EVs.
Battery prices have fallen, making EVs cheaper to build.
headwinds: Ola, Ather, TVS and Bajaj dominate electric scooters.
Homologation and safety testing are expensive and slow.
Battery fires have led to stricter safety rules.
Service and spare parts need a network.
angle_2026: EV two- and three-wheelers are now mainstream, and big companies dominate consumer scooters. In 2026, smaller EV makers grow in niches such as cargo vehicles, fleets, campus mobility or farm equipment, where buyers value ruggedness and service over brand.
cost_basis: Estimated for a small assembly unit building one vehicle type from sourced parts, 2026 prices.

setup_costs.covers: ARAI or ICAT type approval, safety tests

unit_economics.note: Batteries are the biggest cost. Battery swapping or leasing can lower the upfront price for buyers.

investor_probes: What is your battery safety plan?
bootstrap_takeaway: Pick a niche such as cargo, campus or farm use, get type approval, and sell to fleets first.
sourcing_edge: Motors, controllers and battery packs are available from suppliers in Delhi-NCR, Pune and Chennai. Low-speed vehicles under 25 km/h don't need registration, which reduces approvals but limits the market.
licences: ARAI or ICAT type approval (homologation) for road vehicles
Battery safety certification under AIS standards

hard_truths.title: Approvals take time
hard_truths.text: Type approval can take months. Budget for testing.

hard_truths.title: Battery safety
hard_truths.text: Fires damage trust. Use certified cells and BMS.

hard_truths.title: Big competitors
hard_truths.text: Don't fight major brands in consumer scooters.

plan_goal: The aim is a type-approved prototype and orders from one fleet buyer.

plan.title: Pilot
steps: Run a pilot with a fleet.
